lessons_used: Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 6 tests with 2 wins, though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 3 tests with 1 win, though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests, averaging +0.1% after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_flow; adoption, new_screen; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, all showing no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +2.9% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.5% noise-corrected).

candidates.title: Pick friend companion carousel layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a full visual carousel with animated companion preview cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%) with high median completion time (89s).

guard.reason: Valid visual redesign of the pick friend screen layout.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but adoption redesigns show thin historical evidence (+0.6% avg).

candidates.title: Pet companion naming ceremony screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after sign-in before transitioning to the desktop home intro.
candidates.why: The finish step suffers a 29% drop-off rate (71.0% completion). Adding an explicit naming step deepens emotional bond before desktop placement.

new_pet_naming_ceremony.headline: Give Your Pet a Name
new_pet_naming_ceremony.body: Give your companion a unique name before bringing them to your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a pet naming screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses 29% of users, but inserting an extra screen adds friction and lacks strong prior evidence.

candidates.title: Split layout workspace setup waiting screen
candidates.change: Redesign the generation waiting screen into a split layout showcasing live progress metrics and pet hatching animation.
candidates.why: Median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s), leading users to drop off while waiting for pet creation.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the waiting screen displaying pet hatching progress.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median wait time (201s) during home step, but requires full split layout redesign.

candidates.title: Cloud sync reassurance note on sign in
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint to the sign-in screen explaining that signing in saves pet progress to the cloud across desktop app restarts.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your pet data so companion progress is saved across app restarts.

guard.reason: Valid informational hint added to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by 8 support tickets and low-cost sign-in tweak where sign-in changes perform consistently.

candidates.title: Stage layout desktop pet controls showcase
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a showcase stage highlighting desktop shortcut interactions and tray controls.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets asking how to hide, control, or interact with pets after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look for your companion on screen. Double-click to interact or right-click the system tray icon for menu options.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel and support tickets point to post-onboarding confusion; finish redesigns average +1.2% lift.

candidates.title: Desktop habitat backdrop selection screen
candidates.change: Insert a desktop habitat selection screen into the adoption flow where users choose their pet's default desktop perch background.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%). Giving users agency over their pet's environment boosts adoption completion.

new_pet_habitat_selection.headline: Choose Desktop Habitat
new_pet_habitat_selection.body: Select where on your screen your pet prefers to rest and explore.

guard.reason: Valid insertion of a new habitat selection screen in onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact on adoption drop-off, but adding new screens carries friction and weak past evidence (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Setup path clarity and duration copy tweak
candidates.change: Clarify path choice copy by distinguishing quick preset companion pick from custom photo companion creation.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing decision paralysis on path selection.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Setup Experience
choose_path.body: Pick Quick Preset to launch a ready-made companion in under 1 minute, or Custom Studio to create a pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Valid copy update that retains both adoption and pet creation options.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak addressing 514s mean completion time, though path changes historically yield modest lift (+0.1%).

candidates.title: Background generation toggle on waiting screen
candidates.change: Enable background notify when ready toggle and dynamic wait time estimation on the generation waiting screen.
candidates.why: High waiting mean time of 2336s indicates users abandon active waiting windows without knowing they can wait in background.

waiting.body: Generation usually takes 2-3 minutes. Feel free to minimize this window and we will alert you when your pet is ready.

guard.reason: Valid addition of real waiting time estimate and background notification toggle.

candidates.score_note: Targets high mean generation wait time (2336s) by allowing users to wait in the background.

candidates.title: Compact photo upload screen with preview frame
candidates.change: Switch upload photos screen layout to compact mode and embed an explicit reference image preview frame.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 tickets regarding failed photo customization or wrong visual output.

guard.reason: Valid compact layout update for the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 3 support tickets and high adoption step drop-off (39.1%), offering a compact layout fix.

candidates.title: Welcome accessory bonus reward badge
candidates.change: Add a playable reward badge banner on the final home intro screen highlighting a free starter accessory.
candidates.why: Support reported 4 emails requesting additional pet items; providing an immediate unlock increases finish step retention.

components.text: Unlocked: Free Cozy Desk Mat Accessory!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions a free extra ('Free Cozy Desk Mat Accessory!').
